question: Are ω-mag-correct ICs (harvested from s015) close enough to the truth-ω tube for 5-DOF LM (q0 + ω-dir, frozen ω-mag) to bridge into the truth basin?
hypothesis: Re-polishing harvested s015 ICs with frozen ω-mag (5-DOF) bridges into the truth basin (Option C: ω-mag prior is sufficient).
narrative_md: Refuted, but for an unexpected reason. 0/7 seeds reached loose basin with frozen-ω-mag 5-DOF re-polish — but LM did not move from most starts (30/41 ICs changed <1°). The s015 starting points were already converged local minima, so a frozen-ω-mag reparameterization just re-lands at the same minimum. The C hypothesis was tested incorrectly here; it requires fresh ICs at fixed ω-mag (re-tested in s016c_prime). Methodological lesson: re-polishing already-converged ICs with a constrained variant is a vacuous test.
